dictionary_fields.name: algorithm
dictionary_fields.description: DNSSEC algorithm number carried by the record (IANA DNSSEC Algorithm Numbers). Algorithm 0 in CDS/CDNSKEY is the RFC 8078 delete signal.

dictionary_fields.name: digest_type
dictionary_fields.description: DS/CDS digest type (1 = SHA-1, 2 = SHA-256, 4 = SHA-384).

dictionary_fields.name: domain
dictionary_fields.description: Fully qualified domain name that was queried.

dictionary_fields.name: flags
dictionary_fields.description: DNSKEY/NSEC3 flags field, rendered as a string. Only reliably exported in later measurement generations.

dictionary_fields.name: key_tag
dictionary_fields.description: DNSSEC key tag identifying the key a DS/RRSIG/CDS record refers to.

dictionary_fields.name: measurement_id
dictionary_fields.description: Opaque identifier of the individual measurement run or object the row came from.

dictionary_fields.name: rr_type
dictionary_fields.description: DNS resource record type of the observed response record (DNSKEY, DS, RRSIG, NSEC, NSEC3, NSEC3PARAM, CDS, CDNSKEY, ...).

dictionary_fields.name: source
dictionary_fields.description: OpenINTEL measurement source / partition identifier (e.g. the zone file or top list the name was drawn from).

dictionary_fields.name: timestamp
dictionary_fields.description: Measurement timestamp (UTC) at which the DNS response was observed.

dictionary_fields.name: zone
dictionary_fields.description: Zone or TLD the measurement partition belongs to.
